def find_cycle(head):
    slow = head
    fast = head
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
        if slow == fast:
            return True
    return False

    current_sum = 0

def find_intersection(l1, l2):
    set_l2 = set(l2)
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in l1:
        if item in set_l2 and item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result

def count_bits(n):
    result = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        result[i] = result[i >> 1] + (i & 1)
    return result

def rotate_array(nums, k):
    n = len(nums)
    if n == 0:
        return nums
    k %= n
    nums[:] = nums[-k:] + nums[:-k]
    return nums
